What this report is built on. A full census of all 13 schemas and 1,562 tables found 548 populated. Three sources carry genuinely current data: the biometric turnstile log (to 2026-07-13), the user session audit (to 2026-07-15), and the employee master. Everything attendance-related is scoped to the school's own academic year 2025-2026 (2025-08-25 to 2026-07-10) rather than a rolling calendar window. Payroll runs, loans, appraisals, probation and document expiry are absent database-wide — see the Data inventory tab for the full evidence.

All 814 records. One standing column replaces the old Status and Flag pair — every record falls into exactly one category, described under the table.
Present and absent are counted in staff-days, not in people. One employee on one day is one staff-day. So a month with 21 teaching days and 211 staff has a ceiling of about 4,400 staff-days, and "3,026 present" means 3,026 person-days on site — roughly 144 people per day, which is the figure the "staff on site per day" tile shows. Set From and To to the same date and every count switches to plain headcount instead.
Why the HRMS report shows 100% for everyone. Employee Attendance Percentage for 03.05.2026–31.05.2026 reports 29 present, 0 absent, 100% for all 211 staff. Two faults compound: its Total days is the 29 calendar days the range spans — weekends and the Eid Ul Adha break included — and its absent count comes from att_absent_flag = 'A', of which not one row has been written since 2021-08-30. Present is then derived as Total minus Absent, so it can only ever equal Total. Over that same range the turnstile shows only 10 teaching days, and staff such as E1922, E1923, E1927 and the test record E1936 "dummy" registered zero days on site while being reported at 100%. This tab uses teaching days as the denominator and counts presence from punches, which is why its numbers are lower and moving.
Only teaching days count towards absence. Of the 242 days somebody badged in during the year, 79 are not school days — all 32 Sundays (Support staff work Sundays, teachers do not) plus the winter, spring and Eid breaks. On those days only the ~20-strong support and facilities crew is on site. Counting them as school days marked all 114 teachers absent every Sunday and right through the breaks, which is what dragged March down to 9.9%. The split is not a judgement call: 79 days have 2 or fewer teaching staff present and 152 have between 60 and 120, with only 2 days anywhere in between. A day counts as a teaching day when at least 20% of teaching staff are on site. Anyone who did come in on a non-teaching day still counts present — it shows in the Days on site out of term column — but nobody is marked absent.
Worth checking against the school's real calendar: March is empty. Not one teaching staff member registered on the turnstile between 27 February and 20 April — 29 consecutive days on which somebody was on site, with the support crew badging in throughout and the teaching body absent from the log entirely. The holiday calendar only accounts for part of it (spring break is recorded as 9–20 March). March 2026 therefore has zero teaching days and this report shows no attendance for it. A second, milder case runs 12–22 May, where only about 40 of 114 teachers appear. These are equally consistent with a longer school closure than the calendar records or with the badge log dropping teaching staff for seven weeks, and the data alone cannot tell the two apart. Either way marking 114 teachers absent would have been wrong, so absence is not counted — but do not read the gap as a finding about staff until someone confirms which it is.
Built from turnstile punches, not from the attendance module. A day counts as present if the person punched, whatever the calendar says — including the days two staff punched before their own HR joining date. Days before someone joined are never absence. This tab covers the 211 employees whose badge resolves to an HR record. The Attendance analysis tab's headline tiles (1,931 late arrivals, 3,888 days with no out punch) are drawn from a wider population — 238 badge IDs were seen on site in the year — so the totals here are lower and count only people who can be named.

What happened to each HRMS report

Every report on the HRMS Reports menu, what it consolidates into, and where the underlying data does not exist. Verified against the database census, not assumed.
Scoped to academic year 2025-2026 — 2025-08-25 to 2026-07-10, which is year complete. The school had 242 open days in the year, and the last of them was 2026-07-10. Punches stopping after that date is the summer break, not a data gap.
The attendance pipeline is broken, not the staff. Raw turnstile punches arrive normally, but the job converting them into Present/Absent/Late codes has produced nothing since 2021-06-08 — five years. Everything on this tab is computed directly from the punch log and bypasses the broken step entirely.

Tip: click any employee to see their month-by-month attendance below.

Weekend policy versus what the turnstile records. The stated policy is Saturday and Sunday off for everyone, except Admin staff who work Sunday. The attendance data shows the Sunday roles are effectively inverted: of 51 Admin staff who should be in on Sundays, 0 actually are — 36 never worked a single Sunday all year. Meanwhile 41 of 46 Support staff work Sundays even though the policy gives them the weekend off. Either the policy is not being followed, or "Admin" in the policy means the support and facilities crew rather than staff typed A in the HR master.

Weekend policy compliance by staff type

Expected pattern comes from the stated policy, not from the data. Compliance is then measured against actual turnstile attendance across the 32 Sundays and 4 Saturdays the school opened in 2025-2026. Admin are counted as following policy only if present on 60%+ of open Sundays.

Saturday is barely operational — only 4 open Saturdays in the whole year — so a Saturday exception usually means one or two isolated days, not a routine six-day week.

Configured shift templates STALE — DO NOT USE

What the system is configured to believe. The day codes were verified empirically against the old roster (shift "Admin Thursday" was only ever rostered on real Thursdays), which confirms 1 = Sunday through 7 = Saturday. On that mapping every template marks Sunday as working and Friday as off — the pre-2022 UAE weekend. Reality is the reverse: Friday is among the busiest days. The per-employee roster also stopped being written on 2022-08-31. This config has been unmaintained for four years and should not be used for payroll or overtime.

Leave entitlements exist; leave consumption was never recorded. Across the whole database exactly one leave day-count was ever entered (E1555, 6 emergency days, 2021). Because nothing is ever deducted, the balances below are almost certainly overstated. The attendance calendar underneath is the reliable substitute — it shows who was actually on site, from turnstile data.
